propositions: The undecomposed and dod_uncertifiable axes currently use inert ordinal severity labels (low/medium/high) that fail to enable deterministic gate behavior and must be converted to closed Literal kind sets mapping to advisory or flooring consequences.

The undecomposed axis must distinguish three defect kinds (bundles_separable_slices with advisory 0.55 contribution, missing_required_child flooring, no_executable_breakdown flooring) replacing the current indiscriminate floor at any grade.

The dod_uncertifiable axis must distinguish three defect kinds (underspecified_certification with advisory 0.55 contribution, uncertifiable_outcome flooring, certification_cannot_prove flooring) to disambiguate three distinct defects currently masked under one blind floor.

The inert G5-suppressor hedge (veto_undecomposed_g5 fired zero times) must be removed from both verifier prompts and descriptions, and both axes must be rewritten to enumerate kind names and pick rules.
IMPACT_MODEL_VERSION must be bumped from plan-v4 to plan-v5 as a single cohort per ADR 0054 section 4, batching the two shape changes plus decision-margin telemetry.
A zero-LLM re-score script must validate the conversion against 22,667 recorded findings, confirming no unjustified lost blocks on genuine-gap findings as the R1 evidence gate.
